name: Actions & Stuff (Java Port)
description: Unofficial, private fan-made Java Edition port of the Bedrock resource pack "Actions & Stuff" by Oreville Studios (not affiliated or endorsed). Client-side visual mod: re-renders vanilla mobs with animated GeckoLib models. The pack's assets are Oreville Studios' property and are not included in the public source; they are converted locally from your own copy of the pack.
